<script>
let current=1, cakeCut=false;
function go(n){if(n===3 && current!==3){} document.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(c=>c.classList.toggle('active',Number(c.dataset.page)===n));current=n;document.getElementById('bar').style.width=(n/8*100)+'%';window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});}
function unlock(){const p=document.getElementById('pass').value;const e=document.getElementById('err');if(p==='1314'){document.getElementById('lockedPhotos').hidden=false;e.textContent='';document.getElementById('pass').disabled=true;confetti();}else{e.textContent='Oops! Hint yaad karo 😏 Try again!';}}
document.getElementById('pass').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')unlock()});
function words(s){return s.trim()?s.trim().split(/\s+/).length:0}
document.getElementById('q1').addEventListener('input',()=>{let n=words(document.getElementById('q1').value);document.getElementById('wordCount').textContent=n+' / 50 words';document.getElementById('wordCount').style.color=n===50?'#22834d':'#a54e78'});
function submitAnswers(){let n=words(document.getElementById('q1').value),m=document.getElementById('q2').value.trim(),msg=document.getElementById('answerMsg');if(n!==50){msg.textContent='Q1 mein exactly 50 words likho, please! Abhi '+n+' words hain.';return}if(!m){msg.textContent='Q2 ka answer bhi dena hai 😌';return}msg.textContent='';go(8);confetti();}
function cutCake(){if(cakeCut)return;cakeCut=true;document.getElementById('cake').classList.add('cut');document.getElementById('cake').textContent='🍰';document.getElementById('cakeMsg').innerHTML='Cake cut ho gaya! First slice birthday girl ke liye… second slice bhi birthday girl ke liye. Guest ko crumbs milenge 😂💗';confetti();}
function mood(s){document.getElementById('moodMsg').textContent=s}
function confetti(){const bits=['💗','💖','✨','🎉','🌸','💕','🎊'];for(let i=0;i<34;i++){let el=document.createElement('div');el.className='confetti';el.textContent=bits[Math.floor(Math.random()*bits.length)];el.style.left=Math.random()*100+'vw';el.style.animationDelay=Math.random()*.8+'s';document.body.appendChild(el);setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),3600)}}
for(let i=0;i<14;i++){let h=document.createElement('div');h.className='heart';h.textContent=['♡','♥','✧'][i%3];h.style.left=Math.random()*100+'%';h.style.animationDelay=(Math.random()*9)+'s';h.style.animationDuration=(7+Math.random()*6)+'s';document.getElementById('hearts').appendChild(h)}
</script></body></html>
